summary.content: Product designer with eight years in onboarding, payments and design systems for business software. I turn research into shipped, measurable changes and leave teams with tools they keep using.

items.description:
• Led the redesign of onboarding, lifting activation from 41% to 58% in two quarters.
  • Built the design system now used by six product teams; cut interface defects by a third.
  • Ran 40+ customer interviews a year and set up the shared research repository.

• Designed checkout and invoicing for 30 retail clients, raising completed payments by 12%.
  • Introduced usability testing to every release and trained four junior designers.

letters.name: Lumen cover letter
letters.content:
Your posting asks for a designer who can grow a design system across many teams. At Northwind Labs I built ours from a shared Figma library into the system six product teams ship with every week, and cut interface defects by a third along the way.

I’d bring the same habits to Lumen: research before pixels, small releases, and tools that outlive the project.
